usedFor: humanitix holds event orders and Zendesk Support holds tickets, so “New Order” can run “Create Support Ticket”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in humanitix, then “Create Support Ticket” in Zendesk Support
bestTemplate.why: Each order opens a ticket with the requester, priority and tags you set, so support starts with the booking.

watchOut: “New Attendes” in humanitix fires for every attendee, so “Create Support Ticket” could open a ticket per attendee.
